tradeoffs: Opening-edge narrowing is source-safe for this exact canary-free authoring/names-only preparation when capture itself remains installed. It is not a general guarantee for arbitrary source literals/configurations/providers.

No logger namespace exclusions: third-party ROOT-inherited TRACE remains fully exercised once the real secret enters the application. Suppressing those logs would be a different acceptance/security change.
Provider-first arming may reduce preparatory logging work but cannot guarantee healthy1s renewal latency after secret delivery; original fullROOT red and unknown client-completion cause remain.
